title: “I Hadn’t Thought About That”: Creators of Human-like AI Weigh in on Ethics & Neurodivergence
reasoning: The paper is fundamentally focused on the ethics of AI design. It conducts a qualitative study to evaluate the ethical implications of how 'humanness' is defined in AI systems and how these ethical frameworks (or lack thereof) impact neurodivergent individuals. It specifically employs relational ethics to analyze algorithmic injustices.
